ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across the central 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) localized at the distal tips and along segments of the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones are mapped to the lateral-most tips of both lobes. The left distal tip contains a larger, more uniform white region compared to the more fragmented, mottled white distribution on the right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body, roughly 1/8th of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations and jagged pixel-peaks are visible along the entire trailing edge. A series of distinct sharp peaks is prominent on the inner portion of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally straight to slightly concave trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant rectangular notch or missing chunk of tissue is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe, positioned immediately to the right of the central median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric white pigmentation pattern on the distal tips, with the left lobe possessing a more prominent leading-edge white boundary.
